p50.subtitle: Compact, low-noise temporary power for events, retail units, and light site operations.
p50.overview: Our 50 kVA Silent Diesel Generator delivers dependable 40 kW active power inside a compact, weather-resistant acoustic canopy. Engineered for urban Dubai environments where low noise and small footprint matter, it provides clean, stable voltage for outdoor events, retail backup, site cabins, and telecom installations. Every unit is serviced prior to dispatch and backed by Energex's 24/7 UAE technical support team.
applications: Outdoor private parties, weddings, and boutique events
Retail stores, cafes, clinics, and commercial backup
Construction site offices, cabins, and security lighting
Film shoots, exhibitions, and pop-up installations
Telecom towers and light maintenance operations

highlights.title: Ultra-Quiet Canopy
highlights.description: Sound-attenuated enclosure keeps operating noise low for residential neighborhoods and hotel venues.

highlights.title: High Fuel Efficiency
highlights.description: Optimized diesel engine minimizes fuel burn during light and variable load cycles.

highlights.title: Compact Footprint
highlights.description: Easy to transport and position in tight urban spaces, alleyways, and event grounds.

highlights.title: Rapid Deployment
highlights.description: Same-day dispatch across Dubai and neighboring Emirates with fast cable hookup.

faqs.question: How much equipment can a 50 kVA generator power?
faqs.answer: At a 0.8 power factor, a 50 kVA generator supplies up to 40 kW (approx. 72 amps per phase at 400V). It comfortably handles site office ACs, lighting rigs, catering warmers, or small retail loads.

faqs.question: Is the 50 kVA generator quiet enough for events and residential areas?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our 50 kVA units feature sound-attenuated acoustic canopies designed to reduce operational noise, making them suitable for outdoor celebrations, villas, hotels, and noise-sensitive areas in Dubai.

faqs.question: Can I rent a 50 kVA generator for a single day or weekend?
faqs.answer: Yes, Energex offers flexible daily, weekly, and monthly rental plans depending on your event or project duration, including delivery, setup, and collection.

p100.subtitle: Versatile mid-size power for active construction sites, commercial buildings, and medium events.
p100.overview: The 100 kVA Commercial Diesel Generator is one of the most popular workhorses in our Dubai rental fleet, supplying 80 kW of steady prime power. Built for demanding UAE temperatures, it easily supports multi-cabin construction compounds, medium-sized commercial facilities, warehouses, and corporate events. Equipped with digital AVR voltage regulation and comprehensive engine protection, it ensures safe operation for sensitive electronics and motor loads alike.
applications: Construction site compounds, lighting towers, and power tools
Warehouses, cold rooms, and logistics loading bays
Mid-sized corporate events, weddings, and outdoor exhibitions
Offices, showrooms, and commercial building backup
Dewatering pumps and site welding operations

highlights.title: Balanced Capacity
highlights.description: Delivers 80 kW of continuous power—ideal for mixed HVAC, lighting, and motor loads.

highlights.title: Extended Runtime
highlights.description: Generous integrated base fuel tank supports long daily shifts with minimal refuelling stops.

highlights.title: Tropicalized Cooling
highlights.description: Rated to run reliably in high UAE ambient summer temperatures without derating.

highlights.title: 24/7 Fleet Support
highlights.description: Backed by round-the-clock maintenance technicians and emergency unit replacement.

faqs.question: Is a 100 kVA generator suitable for a medium construction site?
faqs.answer: Yes. A 100 kVA generator is widely used on active construction sites in Dubai to power site offices, air conditioning units, floodlighting, small pumps, and fabrication tools simultaneously.

faqs.question: Does Energex provide power cables and distribution boards?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can supply armored power cables, distribution boards (DBs), and Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) alongside your 100 kVA generator rental.

faqs.question: How fast can a 100 kVA generator be delivered in Dubai?
faqs.answer: We offer rapid dispatch across Dubai and all seven Emirates, with same-day delivery available for urgent standby and site requirements.

p250.subtitle: Robust, weatherproof industrial power for major construction works, factories, and large facilities.
p250.overview: Designed for heavy continuous loads, our 250 kVA Industrial Power Generator delivers 200 kW of dependable three-phase electricity. It is an ideal match for mid-to-large construction projects, industrial workshops, manufacturing lines, commercial towers, and large outdoor productions. Featuring smart digital telemetry, automatic shutdown protection, and a rugged soundproof canopy, the 250 kVA unit maintains high voltage stability even under fluctuating inductive loads.
applications: Large building construction sites, hoists, and batching support
Industrial manufacturing plants and fabrication workshops
Hotels, malls, and multi-story commercial building backup
Cold storage facilities and major logistics centers
Large outdoor festivals, concerts, and exhibition pavilions

highlights.title: Smart Monitoring
highlights.description: Advanced digital controller tracks load, voltage, oil pressure, temperature, and run hours.

highlights.title: Heavy Motor Starting
highlights.description: High alternator surge capacity handles starting currents for cranes, chillers, and pumps.

highlights.title: All-Weather Canopy
highlights.description: Powder-coated enclosure protects against dust, sandstorms, humidity, and coastal air.

highlights.title: Flexible Fuel Options
highlights.description: Compatible with external bulk fuel tanks for uninterrupted multi-day continuous operation.

faqs.question: What is the active power output of a 250 kVA generator?
faqs.answer: At a standard 0.8 power factor, a 250 kVA generator produces 200 kW of continuous prime power (roughly 360 amps per phase at 400V).

faqs.question: Can a 250 kVA generator run continuously 24 hours a day?
faqs.answer: Yes, our prime-rated 250 kVA generators are built for continuous 24/7 operation when paired with scheduled preventive servicing and external fuel tank arrangements.

faqs.question: Will Energex help calculate if 250 kVA is the right size?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your equipment list and starting currents with our engineers and we will perform a free load calculation before confirming the generator capacity.

p500.subtitle: High-capacity, parallel-ready power generation for major construction, factories, and mega events.
p500.overview: Our 500 kVA Heavy-Duty Generator Set supplies 400 kW of prime power engineered for high-demand commercial, industrial, and infrastructure applications across the UAE. Whether supporting tower cranes and dewatering systems on a major Dubai construction site, backing up a manufacturing facility during grid maintenance, or synchronizing multiple sets for a mega event, this unit provides exceptional uptime, fuel economy under heavy loads, and full synchronization capability.
applications: High-rise construction projects, tower cranes, and hoists
Large factories, processing lines, and district cooling support
Hospitals, data centers, and major commercial towers
Mega concerts, international exhibitions, and stadium events
Synchronized multi-generator temporary power stations

highlights.title: Parallel Synchronization
highlights.description: Equipped for load-sharing synchronization with additional generators or grid tie-in.

highlights.title: 24/7 Continuous Uptime
highlights.description: Industrial diesel engine built for round-the-clock prime power under demanding loads.

highlights.title: Precision Voltage Control
highlights.description: Digital AVR protects sensitive industrial machinery, chillers, and AV production rigs.

highlights.title: Dedicated Site Support
highlights.description: Includes scheduled preventive maintenance and priority emergency engineer dispatch.

faqs.question: Can multiple 500 kVA generators be synchronized together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our 500 kVA sets are parallel-ready, allowing two or more units to be synchronized for higher total capacity (e.g., 1000 kVA+) or N+1 redundancy on critical projects.

faqs.question: How many amps does a 500 kVA generator provide?
faqs.answer: At 400V three-phase (0.8 power factor), a 500 kVA generator delivers approximately 721 amps per phase, corresponding to 400 kW of active power.

faqs.question: Are ATS panels and external fuel tanks available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), synchronizing panels, heavy-duty cabling, and external bunded diesel tanks to support long-term 500 kVA deployments.

p1000.subtitle: Containerized utility-scale power for major infrastructure, oil & gas, and industrial complexes.
p1000.overview: The 1000 kVA Prime Power Generator is Energex's flagship utility-scale powerhouse, delivering 800 kW of continuous electrical output inside a rugged containerized enclosure. Purpose-built for major infrastructure developments, oil & gas operations, remote industrial camps, seaports, and large manufacturing plants, it handles massive inductive loads with ease. Units can be deployed standalone or synchronized in multi-megawatt power packages with full load management and on-site engineering support.
applications: Mega infrastructure, metro, road, and port development projects
Oil & gas fields, refineries, and remote industrial sites
Heavy manufacturing, steelworks, and large concrete plants
Utility peak-shaving and multi-megawatt temporary power plants
Data centers, hospitals, and major commercial campuses

highlights.title: Containerized Protection
highlights.description: ISO container housing provides maximum durability, security, and weather protection on harsh sites.

highlights.title: Multi-MW Scalability
highlights.description: Advanced load-management controllers enable seamless paralleling into multi-megawatt arrays.

highlights.title: Utility-Grade Stability
highlights.description: Handles massive motor start-up surges and continuous industrial duty cycles reliably.

highlights.title: Turnkey Engineering
highlights.description: Supported by full site survey, crane logistics, HV/LV cabling, and on-site operators if needed.

faqs.question: What industries typically rent a 1000 kVA generator in the UAE?
faqs.answer: 1000 kVA containerized generators are commonly rented for major infrastructure projects, oil and gas facilities, large manufacturing plants, data center backups, and utility-scale temporary power stations.

faqs.question: Can 1000 kVA units be combined for multi-megawatt power?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multiple 1000 kVA generators can be synchronized with load-sharing switchgear and step-up transformers to build scalable multi-megawatt temporary power plants.

faqs.question: Does Energex handle crane delivery and installation for 1000 kVA sets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our logistics and engineering teams coordinate heavy transport, crane offloading, positioning, earthing, cabling, and full load testing prior to handover.
